com.feralinteractive.rometw.overviewZh: 在古罗马背景下经营帝国，在回合制战略地图与即时大规模战斗之间切换。购买前需检查设备兼容性。

positive.zh: 样本认可战役管理的深度、耐玩性，以及将经典 PC 战略体验移植到手机的价值。
positive.en: Reviewers praise the campaign depth, replayability, and the value of a full PC-style strategy game on mobile.

caution.zh: 三条样本都提到触屏战斗操作不够顺手，大规模战斗和转动部队尤其费力。评论来自 2019–2025 年，未验证现版本。
caution.en: All three mention awkward touch controls, particularly large battles and rotating units. These 2019–2025 reports are not a current-version verification.

com.feralinteractive.rometw.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.longyoug.hmby.overviewZh: 以三国为背景，管理城市、任用武将并进行回合制战斗，地形、天气和阵型影响作战。付费下载，另有内购。

positive.zh: 样本认可三国题材、玩法变化和策略深度，有玩家认为手机版接近 PC 体验。
positive.en: The sample praises the Three Kingdoms setting, varied decisions, and depth; one reviewer finds it close to the PC experience.

caution.zh: 较早评论提到存档入口难找、翻译不完整；2026 年一条评论报告大军团手动战斗偶发冻结。
caution.en: Older reviews mention unclear save controls and incomplete translations. A July 2026 reviewer reports occasional freezes in large manual battles.

com.longyoug.hmby.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

air.com.midjiwan.polytopia.overviewZh: 回合制文明策略：探索地图、研究科技、发展部落并与对手竞争，支持单人与多人模式及离线游玩。

positive.zh: 三条样本都给出好评，认可轻量文明策略体验；其中一位觉得一次性购买定价合理。
positive.en: All three sampled reviews are positive about the compact civilization-strategy experience; one praises the one-time pricing.

caution.zh: 样本希望增加合作胜利、剧情或自定义模式，并改善部落平衡和领先后滚雪球的问题。
caution.en: Requests include allied victories, story or custom modes, more tribe variety, and better balance once a player pulls ahead.

air.com.midjiwan.polytopia.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.birdshel.Uciana.overviewZh: 探索随机生成的星系，分配科研、农业与生产资源，并设计舰船参加回合制太空战斗。

positive.zh: 样本认可较完整的太空 4X 和战术战斗，认为低价买断有吸引力。
positive.en: Reviewers value the substantial space 4X systems, tactical battles, and inexpensive upfront purchase.

caution.zh: 有玩家认为教程不足、初期信息过载；2025 年一条评论报告约 200 回合后卡顿和崩溃。
caution.en: The sample flags limited guidance and initial complexity. A May 2025 review reports severe lag and crashes in campaigns beyond roughly 200 turns.

com.birdshel.Uciana.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.playdigious.northgard.overviewZh: 带领维京氏族建设聚落、分配工作并熬过严冬，通过征服、贸易等方式争取胜利；另售氏族 DLC。

positive.zh: 样本肯定核心 RTS 玩法；合作玩家喜欢氏族差异，以及经济和军事等多种胜利方式。
positive.en: The sample values the core RTS design; a co-op player enjoys distinct clans and alternative economic or military win conditions.

caution.zh: 三条 2023–2024 年评论均提到崩溃或加载卡住。不能据此认定当前版本仍有同样问题。
caution.en: All three displayed reviews from 2023–2024 mention crashes or loading hangs. This does not establish the behavior of the current release.

com.playdigious.northgard.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

io.anuke.mindustry.overviewZh: 把工厂供应链、塔防和即时战略结合起来：生产弹药与部队、守卫基地并征服区域，支持合作和对战。

positive.zh: 样本喜欢工厂、塔防与战争的组合，认可内容深度、模组和多人玩法；沙盒也可用于慢节奏体验。
positive.en: The sample enjoys the factory, tower-defense, and warfare combination, with praise for depth, mods, multiplayer, and relaxed sandbox play.

caution.zh: 部分玩家希望增加星球、音乐和单位变化，另有对单位 AI 的改进期待；此样本没有形成明显的重大故障反馈。
caution.en: Some want additional planets, music, and variety, plus improved unit AI. These three reviews do not establish a major recurring technical complaint.

io.anuke.mindustry.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.unciv.app.overviewZh: 开源文明建设游戏，研究科技、发展城市、扩张帝国。开发者明确声明免费、无广告；多人模式需联网。

positive.zh: 样本认可免费无广告、开源和较高重玩价值，认为简洁表现下有丰富的策略选择。
positive.en: Reviewers praise the free, ad-free open-source model, replay value, and substantial strategy beneath a simple presentation.

caution.zh: 玩家提到新手需要适应；一条评论指出教程过于笼统，文字和图标偏小，容易误点部队。
caution.en: New players describe an adjustment period. One reviewer finds the tutorial vague and text and icons small enough to cause accidental selections.

com.unciv.app.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.corrodinggames.rts.overviewZh: 经典即时战略：建造基地、采集资源，指挥陆海空军作战。包含战役、遭遇战与多人玩法，开发者声明无微交易。

positive.zh: 样本认可完整的经典 RTS 机制、模组与联机体验，认为值得购买。
positive.en: The sample praises a complete classic RTS package, mod support, online play, and good purchase value.

caution.zh: 部分玩家需要适应手机界面与操作；还有炮塔平衡、阵营差异和画面升级方面的建议。
caution.en: Touch UI and controls take practice. Other requests concern turret balance, more distinct armies, and improved graphics.

com.corrodinggames.rts.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

yio.tro.achikaps.overviewZh: 简洁的经济策略游戏试玩版，提供沙盒和部分战役内容；商店列出离线与单人模式，开发者声明无微交易。

positive.zh: 样本喜欢简洁画面下的独特玩法和挑战，2026 年一位玩家认为免费试玩内容很充足。
positive.en: Reviewers enjoy the distinctive systems and challenge beneath simple visuals. An August 2026 review finds the free demo generous.

caution.zh: 两条 2019 年评论分别提到战斗重复与存档损坏；年代较早，不能作为当前版本故障结论。
caution.en: Two 2019 reviews mention repetitive battles and corrupted saves respectively. These old reports are not evidence of a current defect.

yio.tro.achikaps.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

age.of.civilizations2.jakowski.lukasz.overviewZh: 跨越多个历史时期的大战略，通过战争、外交与条约改变版图，并使用编辑器创建国家和历史情景。

positive.zh: 样本喜欢外交与国家经营玩法、情景选择和多国游玩，有人认为比更复杂的大战略更容易入门。
positive.en: The sample enjoys the diplomacy, scenarios, and ability to play multiple nations; one finds it more approachable than a heavier grand-strategy title.

caution.zh: 2026 年评论报告长局存档损坏，以及 AI 和谈、经济行为不合理；2024 年另有菜单画面抖动反馈。
caution.en: 2026 reports mention corrupted campaigns and implausible AI peace and economic behavior. A 2024 review also describes screen shaking in menus.

age.of.civilizations2.jakowski.lukasz.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.

com.ironhidegames.android.kingdomrush.overviewZh: 在中世纪奇幻世界中部署防御塔、升级能力并指挥英雄，抵挡敌人进攻。商店标注含广告与内购，支持离线。

positive.zh: 三条样本都给出积极评价，认可塔防挑战、完成度和美术；2026 年一位玩家认为不必付费也能推进。
positive.en: All three sampled reviews are positive about the challenge, polish, and art. A July 2026 reviewer says purchases are not necessary to progress.

caution.zh: 这三条样本没有提供具体负面问题，不等于没有缺点；评论中的付费感受也不改变商店的广告、内购标记。
caution.en: No specific drawback is raised in this small sample. That does not imply none exist, and the store still marks ads and in-app purchases.

com.ironhidegames.android.kingdomrush.method: Human-reviewed synthesis of the public listing’s displayed reviews; not a random or representative sample.
